driving_question: q0124 — the incommunicability axiom: the transformation cannot be transmitted, only enacted. Does any book hand over the lead-to-gold procedure, or do they all just describe the gap?
book: Technic and Magic: The Reconstruction of Reality (Federico Campagna)
best_collision: Campagna reads Heidegger as framing (c01994: the essence of technology is the setting-up which SETS UPON MAN) — but Heidegger's own text (c01341) holds that in that very danger grows the SAVING POWER. Same sentence, opposite weight: one keeps the trap, the other keeps the door.
quote: the essence of technology is nothing technological in itself, but 'the gathering together of that setting-up which sets upon man, i.e., challenges him forth, to reveal the real, in the mode of ordering, as standing-reserve' — p.24-25
mutation_note: The Northern chain hands Technic to us as a closed ring — Spengler names the form (Faustian infinity), Jünger feels the weightlessness inside it, Heidegger frames the frame, Severino makes the frame a destiny. But the frame is where Heidegger hid the door. Campagna, tracing the chain, keeps the trap and drops the soteriology — the saving power is the one thing the Technic reading cannot keep without becoming theology. That drop IS the gap the /x/ axiom points at: the procedure is transducible only as a passage through the frame, never as a thing inside it.
